credit_tiers.section: Appendix B · Premium Plan Cloud Products

credit_basis.quote: Percentage of the monthly fees attributed to the affected Eligible Cloud Product. The percentage of monthly fees attributable to an Eligible Cloud Product when purchased together with other Products under one SKU will be determined by Atlassian.

credit_cap.quote: The aggregate maximum Service Credit applied to an invoice will not exceed 100% of the amount invoiced for the affected Cloud Product in that invoice billing period (which, since Service Credits are applied to future payments, is not the month in which the affected Cloud Product was unavailable).

exclusions.quote: Customer is not entitled to Service Credits if Customer is in breach of the Agreement (as defined below) or has not provisioned the relevant Cloud Product. The Service Level Commitment does not include unavailability to the extent due to: (a) Customer’s use of the Cloud Products in a manner not authorized under the Agreement; (b) force majeure events or other factors outside of Atlassian’s reasonable control, including internet access or related problems; (c) Customer equipment, software, network connections or other infrastructure; (d) Customer Data or Customer Materials (or similar concepts defined in the Agreement); (e) Third-Party Products; or (f) routine scheduled maintenance or reasonable emergency maintenance as stated in the Atlassian Maintenance Policy. The Service Level Commitment does not apply to (i) sandbox instances or Free or Beta Products (or similar concepts in the Agreement) or (ii) features excluded from the Service Level Commitment in the applicable Documentation.

note: AI-assisted proposed corrections on 2026-11-10; human reference review remains pending. The original draft labels and model outputs are preserved. The saved runs were visible during this post-hoc audit, which is not an independent accuracy evaluation.

vendor.reason: SLA §1 identifies Atlassian as the provider.

covered_services.reason: Appendix A explicitly includes Jira; this review selects Jira rather than all products on the page.

plan.reason: Selected Premium plan; Enterprise has a different commitment and extra tier.

measurement_period.reason: Appendix B uses the calendar month, separately for each eligible product.

timezone.reason: UTC applies to measuring calendar months, not automatically the filing deadline.

downtime_definition.reason: One-minute customer error rate strictly greater than 5%; four Jira covered experiences; browser-only scope. Zero requests means zero error rate.

credit_tiers.reason: 10% for [99,99.9), 25% for [95,99), 50% for [0,95); exact boundaries preserved.

credit_basis.reason: Affected-product monthly fees; annual fees prorated by month. Bundle allocation belongs to Atlassian. Reseller fee/remedy rules cannot be represented by this field alone.

credit_cap.reason: 100% of the affected-product amount on the receiving invoice, not the outage-month invoice.

min_credit.reason: Neither frozen page states a minimum amount; absence is not an unfilled extraction.

exclusions.reason: Separate breach from not-provisioned and scheduled from emergency maintenance; add sandbox/Free/Beta scope. Machine-checkability is an implementation annotation, not contract language; only confirmed scheduled-maintenance subtraction is automated here.

prerequisites.reason: Add authorized_requester, stated in the support procedure. A qualifying account/production instance and a timely support ticket do not establish requester authorization.

claim_window.reason: 15 days after month end. The clause does not specify a filing timezone; retain null and conservative engine readings.

claim_procedure.reason: The source requires completed support-form fields without enumerating the proposed five fields. Use other and retain the form-completion reminder. Separate outage support and compensation requests; one compensation ticket per app/month.

remedy_form.reason: Future service credit; unused credit has no cash/refund value and cannot be transferred.

ai_review.exposure: Post-hoc audit; existing labels and saved model runs were visible. This is not an independent held-out experiment.
